subject: FinIntegrate — steering committee & exec sponsor follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha@finintegrate.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.inference>, Logan Wright <logan@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 02 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: FinIntegrate — steering committee & exec sponsor follow-up

Hi Samantha — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Key goals you shared: reduce inference cost per request, guarantee <200ms p95 latency for search workflows, and preserve data residency in us-west.
- Decision timeline: steering committee (exec sponsor + stakeholders) in mid-Dec, procurement + legal to review contract/SLAs after that.
- Stakeholders we heard on the call: Daniel Park (CFO / economic buyer), security (TBD), procurement inbox (procurement@finintegrate.com). Please confirm if that's correct.

Proposed next steps: 
1) Can we lock a 60-min steering committee slot the week of Dec 13? Prefer Tue/Wed mornings PST.
2) Please confirm the exec sponsor (we heard Daniel Park) and any other attendees (engineering lead, security lead, procurement owner).
3) I'll circulate a short steering deck + decision criteria doc for review.

Attached: 20261202-FinIntegrate-discovery-notes.pdf and a draft agenda (FinIntegrate_STEERING_DRAFT_AGENDA.docx).

High level decision criteria we'll include in the deck: TCO (first-year and steady state), performance (latency / p95), data residency & auditability, and operational support / SLA.

Thanks — can you confirm availability and attendees?

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.inference
(415) 555-0123

We can do week of Dec 13. Right now Daniel prefers Tue 12/14 or Wed 12/15 morning PST, but I'll confirm and get a firm slot.

Please share the deck and a 1-page summary of decision criteria for Daniel/finance. Also, procurement usually asks for an initial SOW + SLA summary (1-2 pages) before legal routes redlines.

Date: Wed, 03 Dec 2026 08:20:00 -0800
Subject: FinIntegrate — proposed slots + steering deck v1

Samantha — thanks for confirming. Proposing two candidate slots:

- Tue 2026-12-14 10:00-11:00 AM PST
- Wed 2026-12-15 9:00-10:00 AM PST

I've attached the first draft of the steering deck: FinIntegrate_Steering_Deck_v1.pdf (high level: goals, recommended deployment & cost model, SLAs, decision criteria). Highlights in the deck:

- Recommended configuration: dedicated pool + prefix/KV caching for search to meet the <200ms p95 target.
- Estimated first-year TCO (compute + infra + support) and steady-state per-request cost.
- Compliance: we will provide SOC2 evidence and support KMS integration for key management.

Action items for the Redwood side (internal):
- Rishi: I'll need a commercial one-pager and a short note on pricing bands we can present to finance.
- Laura: please prep an initial SLA summary and any known procurement caveats.
- Hannah: can you compile a SOC2 evidence checklist and a quick note on data residency controls we can share?
- Logan: deploy/runbook summary for the architecture we recommend (1-2 pages).

Samantha — once you confirm the final slot and attendee list (especially Daniel + security lead), we'll lock calendar invite and share the final deck + 1-pagers for procurement.

Regards,
— Marissa
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.inference>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.inference>, Logan Wright <logan@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 03 Dec 2026 09:00:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: FinIntegrate steering prep — who owns what

Team — feeding off the deck I just sent to FinIntegrate, please own the bullets below and aim to have drafts in the shared folder by EOD Mon 12/07: 

- Rishi: commercial one-pager (pricing bands, recommended contract term, any available introductory credits). Put the HubSpot deal link in the doc header (deal RDW-FTG-2026-0043).
- Laura: SLA summary + common procurement redlines we should expect (2 pages). Flag any clauses that require legal escalation.
- Hannah: SOC2 evidence checklist + brief on data residency controls (KMS/HSM, audit logs).
- Logan: deployment/runbook summary (architecture diagram + 1-2 page ops checklist).

I'll draft a one-page steering summary for Daniel focused on decision criteria (TCO, performance, compliance, rollout risk). We'll attach the one-pagers to the invite.

Thanks,
Marissa
